content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Belagavi Cantt Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Belagavi Cantt for various contractual teaching positions for the upcoming academic session.

faq.question: Q2. What posts are available under PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Belagavi Cantt Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions include Post Graduate Teacher (PGT), Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT), and Primary Teacher (PRT) across multiple subjects.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The application mode is via the Samvida Sathi Portal followed by a Walk-in Interview at the designated venue on the specified date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to register on the Samvida Sathi Portal?
faq.answer: The last date to register and submit the application on the Samvida Sathi Portal is 05-10-2026.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and document verification process are scheduled to take place on 06-10-2026 at the Vidyalaya premises.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for PGT, TGT, and PRT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess the requisite educational and professional qualifications as per standard Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS) norms.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for registering or attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry a duly filled bio-data, original educational and identity documents, and self-attested photocopies of all required certificates.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: These positions are offered on a contractual and part-time basis under PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Belagavi Cantt.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official website and notification link?
faq.answer: You can visit the official website at https://no2belagavicantt.kvs.ac.in or check the important links section above for direct updates.
